methods.label: Match opposite coordinates
methods.explanation: For points symmetric about the origin, the corresponding x-coordinates and y-coordinates are opposites. Thus \(a=2\) and \(b=-3\), so \(a+b=-1\).
methods.levelReason: Uses the Grade 9 coordinate-symmetry rule and elementary substitution into a sum.
